Latest industry information on the safety profile of levofloxacin in the US. This paper reviews the safety data for levofloxacin utilizing reports from clinical and post-marketing surveillance trials. The side effect incidence rates are 1.3% for nausea, 0.1% for anxiety, 0.3% for insomnia, and 0.1% for headache. [Efficacy and tolerability of trandolapril in overweight hypertensive patients]. An open multicentre study, performed in 340 overweight (body mass index: BMI > or = 25), hypertensive (95 mmHg < or = DBP < 115 mmHg) patients, evaluated the clinical and metabolic safety of trandolapril and confirmed its antihypertensive activity.
